about: The golden queries of the tool search (direction 40). Each query is a task in the words of a model, and expect lists the tools that answer it. The first 48 queries were written from the tool names before the first run. The last 20 were written on 2026-11-16 before the first run of the synonyms, as a held-out set. The test search-quality.test.ts ranks each query over the tools of the dev-tools server and holds the floors: a drop fails, and a gain fails until the floors record it.
